title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Pricing a Demand Call on the Ticket
content:
## What the ticket prices

Every call worked under the Demand Service Rate Programs is priced from the hours the ticket logs, the
band those hours fell in, the charges the call attracts and the materials used.

## Clauses no longer in force

Two clauses of this basis are no longer in force and are not applied to a call worked today. They are
reproduced so that an older ticket priced under them can still be read:

> Work outside regular hours, on a weekend or on a published office holiday is billed at the tier's regular rate multiplied by the after-hours, weekend or holiday multiplier respectively, and where more than one of those applies to the same hours the highest single multiplier governs and the multipliers are never compounded.

> Labor on a demand call is billed at the tier's regular rate for the lead technician, at the second journeyman rate for each further journeyman and at the apprentice rate for an apprentice, each for the hours that person was on site.

## Clauses in force

**Regular hours.** Regular hours are Monday to Friday, seven in the morning to five in the afternoon, on
the office calendar.

**Minimums and steps.** Every call bills at least the tier's minimum billable hours, or the after-hours
minimum where the call was taken outside regular hours, and hours beyond the minimum are billed in
quarter-hour steps rounded up.

**Trip and diagnostic.** The trip charge is added once per call and the diagnostic fee once per work
order, and where the tier credits the diagnostic fee it is credited in full against the repair when the
repair is authorised on the same visit.

**Travel.** Travel time is billed as labor only where the tier bills it.

**Parts and refrigerant.** Parts are billed at cost plus the tier's markup, less the tier's parts
discount, and refrigerant at the tier's rate per pound.

### Worked illustration of the steps (hypothetical)

Take a call taken in regular hours on a program whose minimum billable hours are 2.0. Where the ticket
logs 1.2 hours, 2.0 hours are billed, the minimum standing. Where it logs 2.1 hours, the hours beyond
the minimum are billed in quarter-hour steps rounded up, so 2.25 hours are billed; where it logs 2.25
hours exactly, 2.25 hours are billed, a quarter-hour step needing no rounding.

### Points of judgement

- The trip charge attaches to the call; the diagnostic fee attaches to the work order, so a second visit
  on the same work order attracts no second diagnostic fee.
- The diagnostic fee is credited in full, and only where the tier credits it and the repair is
  authorised on the same visit.
- The parts markup is taken on the contractor's parts cost, and the parts discount is taken from list
  price; they are separate figures of the tier.

Labor on a demand call is billed at the tier's regular rate for the lead technician, at the second journeyman rate for each further journeyman and at the apprentice rate for an apprentice, each for the hours that person was on site.
